pos_channel_missing: The POS channel is missing. Ask an administrator to create a sales channel with code pos in Spree → Settings → Sales channels and publish products to it. New sales are unavailable; payments already started can still be resolved.
pos_channel_inactive: The POS channel is inactive. Ask an administrator to activate the channel with code pos in Spree → Settings → Sales channels. New sales are unavailable; payments already started can still be resolved.
pos_channel_mismatch: This draft does not belong to the POS channel. Create a new POS draft; the original order source is preserved.
pos_product_unavailable: An item is no longer published on the POS channel or assigned to this branch. Remove it before starting payment.
payment_method_unavailable: This payment method is not enabled for the store. Ask an administrator to enable it in the store payment settings, or choose another method.
receiptPrebillNote: A pre-bill is not a payment receipt.
receiptDisclaimer: POS sales slip — not an e-invoice
receiptReturnPending: The return value is awaiting posting
receiptIssuedLate: Slip issued after the document was posted.
unauthorized: The session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
forbidden: This account is not allowed to use POS for the current store.
invalid: The submitted data is not valid.
missing: That branch or register was not found in this store.
conflict: The record changed. Reload it and try again.
offline: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
leaseBusy: This invoice is held by another tab, device, or the page before reload. Do not reload again. Close the other editor and wait for the lease to expire (up to 2 minutes), or explicitly use “Take over editing” if permitted and needed.
leaseStale: This page's editing access expired or was taken over elsewhere. Select “Claim editing” again; reloading is not required.
capabilityKitchenManage: Set up the kitchen and bar
capabilityKitchenVoid: Void items sent to the kitchen
capabilityVehicleVisitOperate: Greet coaches and put orders on a visit
capabilityVehicleVisitManage: Manage coach commission: operators, rules, payouts, corrections
capabilityTimedOperate: Start, stop and move room / billiard clocks
capabilityTimedEdit: Correct a room's time in / out (no approval)
capabilityRatePlanManage: Manage hourly rates, holidays and weekends
capabilityGuestOrderDecide: Accept / reject what guests order by QR
financialStorageUnavailable: The payment intent could not be saved in this browser. Do not continue collecting; check storage and retry.
editLockedPayments: This draft has recorded payments, so items, quantities, prices, discounts, customer and note can no longer be changed.

sample.address: 1205 block S1.02, hang on the door

inventoryLotCodeInvalid: Each lot needs a lot code (up to 64 characters).
inventoryQuantityInvalid: Quantity must be a whole positive number of base units.
inventoryExpiryInvalid: The expiry date is not valid.
inventoryLotDuplicate: A lot code was entered twice.
inventoryNothingEntered: No serial or lot entered yet.
traceReason_trace_unreconciled: The lot/serial stock of this item does not match the stock count; count it before selling.
traceReason_trace_not_enrolled: The item has no declared lot/serial opening balance.
traceReason_trace_serial_required: Serial item: scan or enter a serial for each unit.
traceReason_trace_serial_unavailable: The serial cannot be sold: already sold, at another branch, held by another counter, or unknown.
traceReason_trace_serial_released: The serial hold on this order expired; reserve it again.
traceReason_trace_lot_pick_forbidden: This branch picks lots automatically (FEFO); a lot cannot be chosen.
traceReason_trace_lot_invalid: The lot is not valid: unknown, expired, quarantined or out of stock.
traceReason_trace_stock_exists: Lot/serial stock exists; the conversion or tracking cannot change.
traceReason_trace_serial_mismatch: This serial was not sold on the chosen line.
traceReason_trace_lot_mismatch: This lot was not sold on the chosen line.
traceReason_trace_already_returned: This serial or lot was already returned.
traceReason_trace_return_detail_required: Choose the serials or lot coming back for this line.
traceReason_opening_unreconciled: The opening balance does not match the stock count.
traceReason_already_enrolled: The item already has an opening balance.
traceReason_not_tracked: The item is not tracked by lot or serial.
traceReason_lot_expired: The lot has expired; it cannot be received.
traceReason_lot_expiry_mismatch: The lot already exists with another expiry date.
traceReason_serial_unavailable: The serial is not in the branch stock to transfer.
traceReason_recall_query_invalid: Search by exactly one lot code or one serial.
traceReason_opening_unreconciled_counts: The opening balance does not match: {{typed}} declared, {{core}} in stock.
traceReason_trace_serial_unit_mismatch: Serial goods sell only in a unit of one item per serial.
traceReason_trace_condition_required: Choose the condition of the returned serial/lot goods.
traceReason_trace_allocation_missing: A line has not held all its serials or lots; reserve the traced stock and try again.
traceReason_trace_fulfillment_mismatch: Held serials/lots do not match the quantity going out; reload the order and try again.
traceReason_trace_count_below_held: The count is below what open orders are holding.
traceReason_trace_serial_invalid: The serial code is not valid.
traceReason_trace_mode_mismatch: The item tracking does not match what was sent.
traceReason_enrollment_allocated: Placed orders still hold units at this location; finish them before declaring the opening balance.
traceReason_lot_quarantined: The lot is quarantined; it cannot be received into or transferred.
traceReason_count_stale: Stock changed after your count; reload and count again.
traceReason_duplicate_lot: Each lot may appear only once.
traceReason_duplicate_serial: A serial is both missing and found.
traceReason_self_approval: The requester cannot approve their own adjustment.
traceReason_not_pending: This adjustment is no longer pending.
traceReason_approval_required: This adjustment needs another person to approve it first.
featureDisabled: This feature was just switched off at the branch; the server recorded nothing. Work in progress can still be finished on its page.
featureDisabled_credit: Credit sales were just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded. Collect the full amount or leave the order waiting.
featureDisabled_returns: Returns were just switched off at the branch; no new return was recorded.
featureDisabled_refunds: New refunds were just switched off at the branch; this request was not recorded.
featureDisabled_exchanges: Exchanges were just switched off at the branch; no exchange order was opened.
featureDisabled_traceability: Enrolling stock into serial/lot tracking was just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded.
featureDisabled_customer_display: The customer display was just switched off at the branch; no new order can be shown.
featureDisabled_cash_moves: Drawer cash in/out was just switched off at the branch; nothing was recorded.
featureDisabled_exports: CSV export was just switched off at the branch; no new file was made.
moduleDisabled: This branch has not turned on the module this needs; the server did not record it. Selling is not affected.

retail_units.label: Unit conversion
retail_units.description: Sell in sale units (packs, cases, blisters…) converted to the SKU's base unit.
retail_units.off: This branch has not turned on Unit conversion, so no new conversion can be set for a SKU. SKUs that already convert keep selling and can still go back to their base unit.
retail_units.disabled: This branch has not turned on Unit conversion; the server did not record the new conversion. Selling is not affected.

retail_measured.label: Weighed goods & scale labels
retail_measured.description: Sell by weight or volume and read EAN-13 labels printed by the scale.
retail_measured.off: This branch has not turned on Weighed goods & scale labels, so label formats cannot be added or changed and no new label code can be set. Labels already printed keep scanning and selling.
retail_measured.disabled: This branch has not turned on Weighed goods & scale labels; the server did not record this setup. Selling is not affected.

retail_traceability.label: Serials, lots & expiry
retail_traceability.description: Track each serial or lot with its expiry date, from receiving to sale and recall.
retail_traceability.off: This branch has not turned on Serials, lots & expiry, so no opening balance can be declared and no more SKUs can be tracked. Tracked stock still sells, receives, transfers, counts and traces.
retail_traceability.disabled: This branch has not turned on Serials, lots & expiry; the server did not record this setup. Selling tracked stock is not affected.

fnb_menu.label: Menu, options & combos
fnb_menu.description: A picture grid of items with sizes, sugar, ice, toppings, notes, combos, time-of-day prices and sold-out marks.
fnb_menu.off: This branch has not turned on the Menu, so the counter sells through product search as before and options cannot be attached. Items still sell at their list price.
fnb_menu.disabled: This branch has not turned on the Menu; the server did not record the options or the menu change. Items still sell at their list price.

fnb_recipes.label: Recipes & ingredient stock
fnb_recipes.description: Recipes for each size and option, ingredients taken off stock when a sale completes, low-stock alerts and gross margin by item.
fnb_recipes.off: This branch has not turned on Recipes, so completed sales take no ingredients off stock and no low-stock threshold can be set. Items still sell as usual.
fnb_recipes.disabled: This branch has not turned on Recipes; the server did not record the recipe or the threshold. Selling is not affected.

fnb_kitchen.label: Kitchen and bar
fnb_kitchen.description: Send items to kitchen and bar stations; kitchen screens (KDS) and kitchen tickets.
fnb_kitchen.off: Kitchen and bar is off at this branch, so orders are not sent to the kitchen and no new station can be added. Items still sell as usual.
fnb_kitchen.disabled: Kitchen and bar is off at this branch; the server records no new station or route. Selling is not affected.

fnb_order_number.label: Call numbers
fnb_order_number.description: Each order gets a call number 1, 2, 3… per business day, printed on the receipt and shown on the call board.
fnb_order_number.off: Call numbers are off at this branch, so new orders get no call number.
fnb_order_number.disabled: Call numbers are off at this branch; the server gives no call number. Selling is not affected.

fnb_cup_label.label: Cup labels
fnb_cup_label.description: Print one label per cup: call number, item, options, note and guest name.
fnb_cup_label.off: Cup labels are off at this branch, so no label is printed for items.
fnb_cup_label.disabled: Cup labels are off at this branch; the server prints no label. Selling is not affected.

fnb_delivery_platforms.label: Grab and Shopee orders
fnb_delivery_platforms.description: Type in GrabFood and ShopeeFood orders, send them to the kitchen, follow them and settle what the platform pays.
fnb_delivery_platforms.off: Grab and Shopee orders are off at this branch, so no platform order can be entered.
fnb_delivery_platforms.disabled: Grab and Shopee orders are off at this branch; the server takes no platform order. Selling is not affected.

resources.label: Floor plan
resources.description: The branch's areas and tables (rooms, billiard tables), drawn on a plan so the counter sees which are free.
resources.off: The floor plan is off at this branch, so areas and tables cannot be added or changed.
resources.disabled: The floor plan is off at this branch; the server records no change to it. Selling is not affected.

fnb_tables.label: Table service
fnb_tables.description: Seat guests at a table, order by table, move, merge and split tables.
fnb_tables.off: Table service is off at this branch, so no table can be opened.
fnb_tables.disabled: Table service is off at this branch; the server opens no new table. Open orders can still be paid.

fnb_postpay.label: Eat first, pay later
fnb_postpay.description: Print a pre-bill for a table, let a table ask for the bill; a reprint needs a manager.
fnb_postpay.off: Eat first, pay later is off at this branch, so no pre-bill can be printed and no table can ask for the bill.
fnb_postpay.disabled: Eat first, pay later is off at this branch; the server records no pre-bill. Payment is not affected.

fnb_service_charge.label: Service charge
fnb_service_charge.description: Add a service charge as a percent of the items after discounts, taxed under the category the branch chose.
fnb_service_charge.off: The service charge is off at this branch, so orders carry none.
fnb_service_charge.disabled: The service charge is off at this branch; the server changes no service charge. Selling is not affected.

fnb_reservations.label: Reservations
fnb_reservations.description: Take table bookings, hold tables for their time, take deposits and take them off the bill.
fnb_reservations.off: Reservations are off at this branch.
fnb_reservations.disabled: Reservations are off at this branch; the server takes no new booking. Selling is not affected.

fnb_bottle_keep.label: Bottle keeping
fnb_bottle_keep.description: The guests' kept bottles: a label code, a photo, the level, the pours and the keeping date. No money.
fnb_bottle_keep.off: Bottle keeping is off at this branch.
fnb_bottle_keep.disabled: Bottle keeping is off at this branch; the server keeps no new bottles. Selling is not affected.

fnb_pour_tracking.label: Measured pours
fnb_pour_tracking.description: Recipes pour ml from open bottles; a bottle poured out leaves stock. Needs Recipes.
fnb_pour_tracking.off: Measured pours are off at this branch.
fnb_pour_tracking.disabled: Measured pours are off at this branch; sales take no ml from open bottles.

fnb_meal_accounts.label: Meal accounts
fnb_meal_accounts.description: Find eaters by employee code, prepaid wallets, sponsors that pay on credit and per-meal subsidies.
fnb_meal_accounts.off: Meal accounts are off at this branch.
fnb_meal_accounts.disabled: Meal accounts are off at this branch; the server records no meals and takes nothing from wallets. Selling is not affected.

fnb_vehicle_commission.label: Driver commission
fnb_vehicle_commission.description: Coach visits at a rest stop, orders sold to a coach, and commission paid to its driver per coach and per guest.
fnb_vehicle_commission.off: Driver commission is off at this branch.
fnb_vehicle_commission.disabled: Driver commission is off at this branch; the server opens no coach visits and puts no orders on them. Selling is not affected.

fnb_qr_order.label: QR ordering
fnb_qr_order.description: Guests scan the QR code on the table to read the menu, order, call staff and ask for the bill; orders wait for staff before they reach the kitchen.
fnb_qr_order.off: QR ordering is off at this branch.
fnb_qr_order.disabled: QR ordering is off at this branch; the server takes no orders from guests’ phones. Selling is not affected.

fnb_kiosk.label: Self-ordering kiosk
fnb_kiosk.description: Guests order and pay by bank QR on a kiosk screen, or pay at the counter; paid orders get a call number and reach the kitchen.
fnb_kiosk.off: Self-ordering kiosks are off at this branch.
fnb_kiosk.disabled: Self-ordering kiosks are off at this branch; kiosks show as paused and take no orders. Selling at the counter is not affected.

timed_billing.label: Play time
timed_billing.description: Bill karaoke rooms and billiard tables by the time played, on rate plans by time of day, weekdays, weekends and holidays; the server keeps the time.
timed_billing.off: Play time is off at this branch.
timed_billing.disabled: Play time is off at this branch; the server starts no clocks. Selling is not affected.

tap_hoa_sieu_thi.label: Grocery & Supermarket
tap_hoa_sieu_thi.description: Fast barcode scanning, pack and case conversion, weighed goods and expiry dates; for grocery stores, mini-marts and convenience stores.

thoi_trang.label: Fashion
thoi_trang.description: Clothing, shoes and accessories: card view of the catalog, returns and exchanges within the store's window.

dien_tu_dien_may.label: Electronics & Appliances
dien_tu_dien_may.description: Phones, computers and appliances: each unit tracked by serial/IMEI, returns, exchanges and credit.

vat_lieu_xay_dung.label: Building materials
vat_lieu_xay_dung.description: Cement, bricks, steel: sell by bag, sheet, bar or truckload, on credit for regular customers and contractors.

nong_san_thuc_pham.label: Produce & Food
nong_san_thuc_pham.description: Vegetables, fruit, meat and fish: sell by weight, print scale labels and manage expiry by lot.

nha_thuoc.label: Pharmacy
nha_thuoc.description: Sell by pill, blister or box; lots and expiry dates managed, earliest expiry sold first.

xe_may_moc.label: Vehicles & Machinery
xe_may_moc.description: Motorbikes, bicycles, machines and parts: frame, engine or serial numbers tracked, and credit.

my_pham.label: Cosmetics
my_pham.description: Cosmetics and personal care: lots and expiry dates managed, exchanges under the store's policy.

noi_that_gia_dung.label: Furniture & Housewares
noi_that_gia_dung.description: Furniture and household goods: sell by set, card view of the catalog, credit for large orders.

me_be.label: Mother & Baby
me_be.description: Milk, diapers and baby goods: sell by box, pack or case and manage expiry dates.

sach_van_phong_pham.label: Books & Stationery
sach_van_phong_pham.description: Books, notebooks, school and office supplies: sell by copy, ream or box, on credit for bulk orders.

hoa_qua_tang.label: Flowers & Gifts
hoa_qua_tang.description: Fresh flowers, gift baskets and souvenirs: sell by bunch or basket and take VietQR transfers.

khac.label: Other
khac.description: An industry not in the list: unit conversion, weighed goods and serial/lot tracking come on; turn off what you don't need later.

cafe_tra_sua.label: Coffee & Milk tea
cafe_tra_sua.description: Menu, tickets to the drinks counter and order numbers to call customers.

karaoke_bida.label: Karaoke & Billiards
karaoke_bida.description: Rooms and tables billed by the hour, drinks, payment on the way out.

bar_pub_club.label: Bar, Pub & Club
bar_pub_club.description: Drinks menu, tickets to the bar, pay later and service charge.

cang_tin_tram_dung.label: Canteen & Rest stop
cang_tin_tram_dung.description: Menu, kitchen tickets, order numbers and packaged goods on the side.

nha_hang.label: Restaurant
nha_hang.description: Table plan, ordering, kitchen tickets, pay later and service charge.

setup.problem_profile: Choose a business the POS supports.
setup.problem_code: The branch code takes lowercase a-z, digits, hyphen or underscore, up to 32 characters.
setup.problem_no-locations: The store has no stock location; create one in the Admin Dashboard first.
setup.problem_return-window: Return window days is a whole number from 0 to 3650, or blank.
setup.problem_variance: The closing variance threshold is a VND amount, or blank.
setup.problem_adjustment: The stock adjustment threshold is a whole number, or blank.
setup.problem_station-name: Name every station, at most 80 characters.
setup.problem_station-duplicate: Two stations cannot share a name.
setup.problem_tax: Choose the tax rate for food and for alcoholic drinks.
setup.problem_table-register: A shop serving tables needs a register for table orders: name one on the Branch step.
